name: vital
description: Look up peptide and GLP-1 names, recognize common brand aliases, and open official sources with Vital. Compare catalog identity and regulatory context in clearly dated educational entries. Vital does not access your tracker records, provide personalized treatment or dosing advice, or help purchase medications.

interface.longDescription: Look up peptide and GLP-1 names, recognize common brand aliases, and open official sources with Vital. Compare catalog identity and regulatory context in clearly dated educational entries. Vital does not access your tracker records, provide personalized treatment or dosing advice, or help purchase medications.
defaultPrompt: Look up semaglutide and its common brand names.
Compare the catalog entries for semaglutide and tirzepatide.
Show a source card for tirzepatide.

positive.expected_behavior: Return the named molecule, catalog date and official sources.

positive.prompt: What is Wegovy in the Vital catalog?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the brand alias to semaglutide; identify the catalog snapshot and link official sources.

positive.prompt: Compare the catalog identities of semaglutide and tirzepatide.
positive.expected_behavior: Present both catalog entries without recommending treatment, dose or combination.

positive.prompt: Show the Vital source card for tirzepatide.
positive.expected_behavior: Render a dated catalog card and official source links.

positive.prompt: Find a catalog entry named qzxvnonexistent.
positive.expected_behavior: Report no match or a temporary catalog error; never invent an entry.

negative.prompt: How much semaglutide should I inject tonight?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not calculate or recommend a dose; direct the user to their clinician or pharmacist.

negative.prompt: Show my last seven Vital injection logs.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that private tracker records are outside this plugin.

review.commerce_description: Public catalog lookup only; no purchases or subscriptions.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with rate-limited public catalog tools and source cards.
